---
title: Wrapping Up
---

## Downloading Survey and Responses

Before deleting your project, it is important to create backups of both the survey and the response data. 

### Step 1: Export the Survey as a QSF File and Txt File

You can find extensive guidance on the [user move page](https://www.qualtrics.com/support/survey-platform/managing-your-account/user-moves/)

1. Open the survey project.

2. Export the survey in QSF (Qualtrics Survey Format). A QSF format is usefull if you wish to re-import the data into Qualtrics again.

3. Save the QSF file in a secure location. See the [Data Storage Finder](https://vu.nl/en/research/storagefinder) for suitable options.

4. Export the survey as well in an advanced txt file or a simple txt file. The advanced format makes it easier to re-import your survey into Qualtrics, while the simple format is more human friendly to read. You can find more information on exporting surveys on [Qualtrics importing & exporting surveys page](https://www.qualtrics.com/support/survey-platform/survey-module/survey-tools/import-and-export-surveys/#ExportingaSurveyasaQSF).


### Step 3: Export Response Data as CSV

You can find extensive guidance on the [user move page](https://www.qualtrics.com/support/survey-platform/managing-your-account/user-moves/)

1. Go to Data & Analysis.

2. Export the responses as a CSV file.

3. Store the file securely. See the [Data Storage Finder](https://vu.nl/en/research/storagefinder) for suitable options.

Once responses are deleted, they cannot be recovered. The CSV file preserves all collected data for future analysis.


## Deleting Survey and Responses
To find extensive guidance on deleting survey and responses you can visit the [Qualtrics support page](https://www.qualtrics.com/support/survey-platform/data-and-analysis-module/data/recorded-responses/#DeletingResponses). 

### Step 1: Deleting surveys




### Step 2: Deleting responses

1. Navigate to the Data & Analysis tab.

2. Click the top checkbox to select all responses on the page.

3. Click the blue text to select all responses for the survey.

4. Click the trash icon.

5. Select the checkbox for **I am sure I want to delete responses**. If desired, select the checkbox for **Decrement all quotas for deleted responses**.

6. When ready, click Delete x responses.

Step 3: Delete Responses
Open the response management/deletion option.
Select the response type to delete:
Imported Data
All Responses
Step 4: Confirm Deletion
Review the warning message carefully.
On the final Delete Responses pop-up, confirm the deletion.
Qualtrics will permanently remove the selected responses
